hooks.name: Auto-commit on file save
hooks.description: Automatically stages, commits, and pushes changes whenever you save a file in src/, server/, shared/, or public/ directories

action.command: cd "$env:KIRO_WORKSPACE_PATH" && git add -A && git commit -m "Auto-commit: Changes to $(Split-Path -Leaf $env:KIRO_FILE_PATH)" && git push origin main
